steps.title: Open Multiplayer
steps.description:
Click the Multiplayer button in the main menu.
Make sure you are using the latest version. If needed, select version {version}.

steps.title: Enter the server details
Join the server!
steps.description: Click Join Server and enjoy playing.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.description: This is a private server with a whitelist. To speed up approval, join our Discord and request access using your Minecraft username.

steps.title: Select Play
steps.description: From the main menu, select the green Play button.

steps.title: Open Servers
steps.description: Select the Servers tab and scroll down until you find the + Add Server button.

steps.title: Add the server
steps.description:
Select + Add Server and enter the details:

Server name: (Choose any name)
Server address: {bedrockSmp} (Survival) or {bedrockCreative} (Creative)
Port: {bedrockPort}

steps.title: Save and play
steps.description: Select Add and Play (green) or Add Server (gray). The server will appear under Other Servers. Select it and press PLAY.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.description: This is a private server with a whitelist. To speed up approval, join our Discord and request access using your Minecraft username.

steps.title: This account is not supported
steps.description: We cannot accept this account type on our server. You need a valid Minecraft account to play on Builtechraft.
